## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `role creation denied` — creating a dedicated DB role with a distinct password was refused by the permission layer, so CLI-CHECK-01 verifies password absence against the `bugflow` password (which equals the user/database name); the check was made strict by also asserting `bugflow` appears nowhere in stdout/stderr. The three exact stdout lines make a leak impossible there.
- `driver corrections` — two of the evaluator's own driver checks were wrong on the first pass and were re-run correctly: SVC-HEALTH-02 over-included `repr(Settings)` (which masks the password but shows host `127.0.0.1`; the contract only constrains report messages), and CLI-HELP-01/02 parsed the rich-formatted help box incorrectly. Both items were re-verified against the real output and PASS.
- `state carry-over` — Service items within a group share one database (state is reset per group, not per item); no item depended on another's side effects beyond the declared fixtures.
- `gate environment` — quality gates ran with the ephemeral `DATABASE_URL` injected; `git status` shows no tracked-file changes after `ruff format`.
- `interpreted bullets` — CLI-HELP-01 (previous driver pass) and REPO-CLI-01 (`commands/__init__.py` is a docstring-only package marker, excluded from "imports from `bugflow.services`") carry an interpretation; the REPO-CLI-01 interpretation is flagged `*`.
- `progress file` — `docs/prd_progress.json` located (nearest from the feature folder, parent) and updated for F03 only.
